_comment: The turn-time popups' own words in HD (work order 188, open fix 49; core/turnpopup.py) where the original's word is ARTWORK, not a string: TURNSUM.LBX 1-3 (the up, down and OK buttons, turnsum.cpp:134-153), the BUFFER0.LBX popup's cancel button, the science room and the GNN, which are answered by a click anywhere. Typed here per decision 15; the player's mod folder replaces this file. The hire popup's REJECT and HIRE are artwork too (ESTRINGS 0x13C and 0x1B4 are their hotkey LETTERS, H and R — seen live, work order 188), and TURN SUMMARY is TURNSUM.LBX's title art. The colony combat popup's buttons (work order 232 C) are MAINPUPS.LBX art too: CANCEL 0x52, INVADE 0x36, BOMBARD 0x37 (the choice's and the bombing's), DESTROY 0x35, MIND CONTROL 0x50 (0x51 the same word greyed), DROP ALL 0x4F, HALT 0x3C (the field the source calls cease fire). The Space Dragon's bribe (work order 319): NO 0x46 (beside YES; alone it reads CLOSE, the key above), YES 0x47.
